name: ash
description: ash — the personal-agent layer on top of DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

scripts.test:smoke: node --expose-internals --import tsx --test packages/sdk/test/*.test.ts packages/link/test/*.test.ts packages/workspace/test/*.test.ts packages/core/test/arch/*.test.ts packages/core/test/edges/*/*.test.ts packages/core/test/edges/*/*/*.test.ts packages/core/test/kernel/*/*.test.ts packages/core/test/services/*/*.test.ts tools/container-sources.test.mjs tools/gen-ash-tokens.test.mjs tools/e2e/scenarios.test.mjs tools/release-gate.test.mjs packages/ash-cost/test/*.test.ts packages/dsh-ash-control/test/*.test.ts packages/ash-skills/test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run -s gen:ui && npm run -s gen:rules && npm run -s gen:widget-cards && tsc --noEmit -p .
scripts.test: npm run -s gen:ui && npm run -s gen:rules && npm run -s gen:widget-cards && node --expose-internals --import tsx --test packages/*/test/*.test.ts packages/core/test/arch/*.test.ts packages/core/test/edges/*/*.test.ts packages/core/test/edges/*/*/*.test.ts packages/core/test/kernel/*/*.test.ts packages/core/test/services/*/*.test.ts tools/container-sources.test.mjs tools/gen-ash-tokens.test.mjs tools/e2e/scenarios.test.mjs tools/release-gate.test.mjs packages/core/test/scenarios/*.test.ts packages/web/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:ui:e2e: npm run -s gen:ui && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=180000 packages/web/test/e2e/*.test.js
scripts.build:core: npm run -s gen:ui && npm run -s gen:rules && esbuild packages/core/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=packages/core/dist/ash-core.mjs "--define:__ASH_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\"" --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'node:module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:payload: npm run -s build:core && node payload/assemble.mjs --out build/payload
scripts.build:device: node tools/build-device-state-lock.mjs && node tools/build-device-listener-evidence.mjs && esbuild packages/device/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=packages/device/dist/ash-device.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'node:module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);"
